source("config.local.R")

# Variant-motif overlap summary plots (Figure 5A)
## =========================
## Script summarizing variant-motif overlap
## =========================
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(cowplot)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(scales)
library(data.table)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)
library(forcats)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(ggseqlogo)
options(bitmapType = "cairo")

paths <- paths_figure5

source(paths$color_pallete_helper)
source(paths$track_plots_helper)
source(paths$cbpnet_extract_helper)

## =========================
## 1) Load motif–variant hits
## =========================

unique_hits <- read_tsv(paths$filtered_variant_hits)

## Order TF families by # of variants with motif hits (ChromBPNet universe)
tf_counts <- unique_hits %>%
  group_by(family) %>%
  summarise(
    total_hits = n_distinct(variant_loc),   # unique variants per family
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_hits))

tf_order  <- tf_counts$family
n_colors  <- length(tf_order)
my_colors <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(8, "Blues"))(n_colors)

## =========================
## 2) Load ChromBPNet predictions
## =========================

var_prediction <- read_tsv(paths$variant_prediction_scores_ips05) %>%
  mutate(var_chr_pos = paste(chr, pos, sep = "_")) %>%
  # keep only variants present in unique_hits
  semi_join(
    unique_hits %>%
      transmute(var_chr_pos = paste(seqnames, variant_loc, sep = "_")),
    by = "var_chr_pos"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(variant_id, chr, pos, allele1, allele2, logfc.mean, jsd.mean, var_chr_pos) %>%
  group_by(var_chr_pos) %>%
  filter(n() == 1) %>%        # drop positions with multiple prediction rows
  ungroup()

## =========================
## 3) QTL overlap annotation
## =========================

summary_df <- read_delim(paths$summary_df)

chrombpnet_vars <- var_prediction$variant_id

## caQTL side
ca_all <- summary_df %>%
  mutate(
    var_id = gsub(
      "([0-9]+):([0-9]+)\\[b38\\]([A-Z]),([A-Z])",
      "chr\\1_\\2_\\3_\\4",
      variant_id.x
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(var_id %in% chrombpnet_vars) %>%
  pull(var_id) %>%
  unique()

## eQTL side
eq_all <- summary_df %>%
  mutate(
    var_id = gsub(
      "([0-9]+):([0-9]+)\\[b38\\]([A-Z]),([A-Z])",
      "chr\\1_\\2_\\3_\\4",
      variant_id.y
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(var_id %in% chrombpnet_vars) %>%
  pull(var_id) %>%
  unique()

rm(summary_df)

qtl_any <- union(ca_all, eq_all)

variant_status <- tibble(
  variant_id = chrombpnet_vars
) %>%
  mutate(
    is_qtl  = variant_id %in% qtl_any,
    category = if_else(is_qtl, "QTL_shared", "ChromBPNet_specific")
  )

var_prediction <- var_prediction %>%
  left_join(variant_status, by = "variant_id")

## =========================
## 4) Peak annotation (promoter / distal)
## =========================

## ATAC peaks used by ChromBPNet
bp.peaks <- fread(chrombpnet_peaks_path)
bp.peaksGR <- GRanges(
  seqnames = bp.peaks$V1,
  ranges   = IRanges(bp.peaks$V2, bp.peaks$V3),
  peak_name = bp.peaks$V4
)

## Gencode gene TSSs
gencode <- fread(
  gencode_bed_path,
  sep = "\t", data.table = FALSE
) %>%
  transmute(
    chr        = V1,
    strand     = V6,
    gene_id    = V7,
    gene       = V4,
    tss_1based = if_else(V6 == "+", V2 + 1L, V3)
  ) %>%
  distinct(chr, gene, .keep_all = TRUE)

tss_gr <- with(
  gencode,
  GRanges(
    seqnames = chr,
    ranges   = IRanges(start = tss_1based, end = tss_1based),
    strand   = strand
  )
)

ov_tss <- countOverlaps(bp.peaksGR, tss_gr, ignore.strand = TRUE)
mcols(bp.peaksGR)$promoter   <- ov_tss > 0
mcols(bp.peaksGR)$annotation <- if_else(mcols(bp.peaksGR)$promoter, "promoter", "distal")

## Map variant_id → peak_annotation
vars_GR <- variant_status %>%
  separate(
    col   = variant_id,
    into  = c("chr", "pos", "ref", "alt"),
    sep   = "_",
    remove = FALSE
  ) %>%
  mutate(pos = as.integer(pos)) %>%
  {
    GRanges(
      seqnames   = .$chr,
      ranges     = IRanges(start = .$pos, end = .$pos),
      strand     = "*",
      is_qtl     = .$is_qtl,
      category   = .$category,
      ref        = .$ref,
      alt        = .$alt,
      variant_id = .$variant_id
    )
  }

hits <- findOverlaps(vars_GR, bp.peaksGR, ignore.strand = TRUE)

ann_vec  <- rep(NA_character_, length(vars_GR))
name_vec <- rep(NA_character_, length(vars_GR))

ann_vec[queryHits(hits)]  <- mcols(bp.peaksGR)$annotation[subjectHits(hits)]
name_vec[queryHits(hits)] <- mcols(bp.peaksGR)$peak_name[subjectHits(hits)]

mcols(vars_GR)$peak_annotation <- ann_vec
mcols(vars_GR)$peak_name       <- name_vec

var_tss <- tibble(
  variant_id     = vars_GR$variant_id,
  peak_annotation = vars_GR$peak_annotation
)

var_prediction <- var_prediction %>%
  left_join(var_tss, by = "variant_id")

## =========================
## 5) Base per-variant–motif table (for plots)
## =========================

base_df <- unique_hits %>%
  mutate(var_chr_pos = paste(seqnames, variant_loc, sep = "_")) %>%
  left_join(var_prediction, by = "var_chr_pos") %>%
  filter(!if_any(c(logfc.mean, jsd.mean), is.na)) %>%
  distinct(variant_id, motif_name, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%    # 1 row per variant–motif
  mutate(
    TF_family = factor(family, levels = rev(tf_order))
  )

## =========================
## 6) Allelic importance Δ (allele2 - allele1)
## =========================

allelic_ratio_df <- unique_hits %>%
  mutate(var_chr_pos = paste(seqnames, variant_loc, sep = "_")) %>%
  left_join(var_prediction, by = "var_chr_pos") %>%
  filter(!if_any(c(logfc.mean, jsd.mean), is.na)) %>%
  dplyr::select(variant_id, motif_name, family, allele, hit_importance) %>%
  group_by(variant_id, motif_name, family, allele) %>%
  summarise(
    hit_importance = mean(hit_importance),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = allele,          # assumes columns "allele1", "allele2"
    values_from = hit_importance
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    allele1    = replace_na(allele1, 0),
    allele2    = replace_na(allele2, 0),
    allele_diff = if_else(
      allele1 == 0 & allele2 == 0,
      NA_real_,
      allele2 - allele1
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(allele_diff)) %>%
  mutate(
    TF_family = factor(family, levels = rev(tf_order))
  )

## =========================
## 7) Per-family master summary table
## =========================
write_csv(base_df, paths$motif_hits_summary_annotations)

## Core family-level stats from base_df
family_core <- base_df %>%
  group_by(family) %>%
  summarise(
    n_var_motif   = n(),                               # variant–motif instances
    n_variants    = n_distinct(variant_id),            # distinct variants with motifs
    median_logfc  = median(logfc.mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_qtl         = sum(is_qtl, na.rm = TRUE),
    frac_qtl      = n_qtl / n_variants,
    n_promoter    = sum(peak_annotation == "promoter", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_distal      = sum(peak_annotation == "distal",   na.rm = TRUE),
    frac_promoter = n_promoter / n_variants,
    frac_distal   = n_distal   / n_variants,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

## Allelic importance summary
allelic_summary <- allelic_ratio_df %>%
  group_by(family) %>%
  summarise(
    median_allele_diff = median(allele_diff, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

## Master summary table
family_summary <- family_core %>%
  left_join(allelic_summary,   by = "family") %>%
  left_join(tf_counts,   by = "family") %>%
  mutate(
    TF_family = factor(family, levels = rev(tf_order))
  ) %>%
  arrange(TF_family)

write_tsv(family_summary, paths$motif_family_summary_table)


write_tsv(var_prediction, paths$var_pred)

family_summary <- read_tsv(paths$motif_family_summary_table)

mean(family_summary$frac_qtl)

#motif_list <- motif_list[tf_order[tf_order %in% names(motif_list)]]

# --- 2) build family-ordered list by TF names, then rename to families ---
# invert mapping: family -> representative motif name
family_to_motif <- setNames(names(rep_map), unname(rep_map))
family_to_motif <- family_to_motif[tf_order[tf_order %in% names(family_to_motif)]]

# desired family order: keep your tf_order, then any extra families from rep_map
families_in_map <- names(family_to_motif)
family_order <- c(intersect(tf_order, families_in_map),
                  setdiff(families_in_map, tf_order))

motifs_needed <- unname(family_to_motif[family_order])
present <- motifs_needed %in% names(motif_list)

# --- optional: fallback if representative motif is missing but you have tf_map ---
logo_strength <- function(mat) sum(abs(mat))  # good for CWMs
if (any(!present) && exists("tf_map")) {
  missing_fams <- family_order[!present]
  # candidates among *available* motifs that belong to the same family
  # tf_map is motif -> family
  available <- intersect(names(tf_map), names(motif_list))
  cand_tbl <- tibble(
    motif  = available,
    family = unname(tf_map[available]),
    strength = map_dbl(available, ~ logo_strength(motif_list[[.x]]))
  )
  for (fam in missing_fams) {
    cand <- cand_tbl %>% filter(family == fam)
    if (nrow(cand) > 0) {
      best <- cand %>% slice_max(strength, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>% pull(motif)
      motifs_needed[family_order == fam] <- best
      present[family_order == fam] <- TRUE
      message("Fallback for '", fam, "': using motif '", best, "'.")
    }
  }
}

# drop families still missing
if (any(!present)) {
  warning("Dropped families without available motif matrices: ",
          paste(family_order[!present], collapse = ", "))
}
family_order_kept <- family_order[present]
motifs_kept <- motifs_needed[present]

if (!is.null(paths$r_libs)) {
  .libPaths(paths$r_libs)
}

setwd(paths$plot_dir)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(data.table)

source(paths$track_plots_helper)
source(paths$cbpnet_extract_helper)

# Ensure exporter initialized once
stopifnot(exists(".init_variant_bw_exporter"))
.init_variant_bw_exporter() #IF Rstudio is on >[BROWSE] it will fail, run Q nd restart session

# ============================================================
# Paths / Inputs
# ============================================================
# All paths are loaded from paths_figure5 in the config file above.

# ============================================================
# Helpers
# ============================================================

parse_variant_id <- function(variant_id) {
  x <- trimws(variant_id)
  
  mA <- stringr::str_match(x, "^chr([0-9XYMT]+)_([0-9]+)_[ACGT]_[ACGT]$")
  if (!is.na(mA[1, 1])) return(list(chr = paste0("chr", mA[1, 2]), pos = as.integer(mA[1, 3])))
  
  mB <- stringr::str_match(x, "^([0-9XYMT]+):([0-9]+)\\[b\\d+\\][ACGT],[ACGT]$")
  if (!is.na(mB[1, 1])) return(list(chr = paste0("chr", mB[1, 2]), pos = as.integer(mB[1, 3])))
  
  stop('Unrecognized variant_id format. Allowed: "chr6_113306741_G_A" or "6:113306741[b38]G,A".')
}

make_ld_bins <- function(r2) {
  cut(
    r2,
    breaks = c(0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1),
    labels = c("0.0–0.2", "0.2–0.4", "0.4–0.6", "0.6–0.8", "0.8–1.0"),
    include.lowest = TRUE,
    right = FALSE
  )
}

ld_colors <- c(
  "0.0–0.2" = "gray",
  "0.2–0.4" = "skyblue",
  "0.4–0.6" = "green",
  "0.6–0.8" = "orange",
  "0.8–1.0" = "red"
)

add_ld_from_lead <- function(markers_df, LD_mat, lead_pos) {
  LD_mat <- as.matrix(LD_mat)
  lead_index <- which.min(abs(markers_df$pos_hg38 - lead_pos))
  ld_cor <- LD_mat[, lead_index]
  markers_df$ld_r_gwas  <- ld_cor
  markers_df$ld_r2_gwas <- ld_cor^2
  markers_df$ld_bin_gwas <- make_ld_bins(markers_df$ld_r2_gwas)
  markers_df
}

plot_qtl_scatter <- function(markers_df, minStart, maxEnd, label_txt, region,
                             ylab_expr = bquote(-log[10](p))) {
  
  markers_df <- markers_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      p = 2 * stats::pnorm(-abs(z_pos0)),   # two-sided p from Z
      y = -log10(p)
    )
  
  y_finite <- markers_df$y[is.finite(markers_df$y)]
  ymax <- if (length(y_finite)) max(y_finite, na.rm = TRUE) else 1
  
  step <- dplyr::case_when(
    ymax <= 5  ~ 1,
    ymax <= 20 ~ 2,
    ymax <= 50 ~ 5,
    TRUE       ~ 10
  )
  maxlimit <- ceiling(ymax / step) * step
  
  ggplot(markers_df, aes(x = pos_hg38, y = y)) +
    geom_point(
      aes(fill = ld_bin_gwas),
      shape = 21, size = 2, alpha = 0.8, color = "gray20", stroke = 0.2
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = ld_colors, name = expression(LD~(r^2))) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(minStart, maxEnd)) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, maxlimit)) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = minStart,
      y = maxlimit,
      label = label_txt,
      hjust = 0, vjust = 1,
      size = 4
    ) +
    labs(y = ylab_expr, x = "") +
    BPCells:::trackplot_theme() +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 11, angle = 90, vjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0.5)
    ) +
    highlight_region(region, color = "skyblue", alpha = 0.2)
}

}

# ============================================================
# Helpers for automatic feature-inclusive windows
# ============================================================

parse_region_bounds <- function(region_string, chr_prefix = TRUE) {
  # accepts either "10:42087130-47810680" or "chr10:42087130-47810680"
  region_string <- as.character(region_string)
  region_string <- sub("^chr", "", region_string)
  
  chr <- sub(":.*$", "", region_string)
  coords <- sub("^[^:]+:", "", region_string)
  
  start <- as.integer(sub("-.*$", "", coords))
  end   <- as.integer(sub("^.*-", "", coords))
  
  if (chr_prefix) chr <- paste0("chr", chr)
  
  tibble::tibble(chr = chr, start = start, end = end)
}

get_peak_bounds <- function(peak_id, bed_peaks_gr) {
  mc <- as.data.frame(GenomicRanges::mcols(bed_peaks_gr))
  
  possible_cols <- intersect(
    c("name", "peak", "peak_id", "X4", "V4"),
    colnames(mc)
  )
  
  if (length(possible_cols) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  hit <- rep(FALSE, length(bed_peaks_gr))
  
  for (cc in possible_cols) {
    hit <- hit | as.character(mc[[cc]]) == as.character(peak_id)
  }
  
  if (!any(hit)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  gr <- bed_peaks_gr[hit][1]
  
  tibble::tibble(
    chr   = as.character(GenomicRanges::seqnames(gr)),
    start = GenomicRanges::start(gr),
    end   = GenomicRanges::end(gr)
  )
}

get_gene_bounds <- function(gene_id, transcripts) {
  # Works with either a GRanges transcript annotation or a tibble/data.frame
  
  gene_cols <- c("gene_name", "gene", "gene_id", "symbol", "external_gene_name", "tx_name")
  
  if (methods::is(transcripts, "GRanges")) {
    mc <- as.data.frame(GenomicRanges::mcols(transcripts))
    
    possible_gene_cols <- intersect(gene_cols, colnames(mc))
    if (length(possible_gene_cols) == 0) {
      return(NULL)
    }
    
    hit <- rep(FALSE, length(transcripts))
    for (cc in possible_gene_cols) {
      hit <- hit | as.character(mc[[cc]]) == as.character(gene_id)
    }
    
    if (!any(hit)) {
      return(NULL)
    }
    
    gr <- GenomicRanges::reduce(transcripts[hit])
    
    return(tibble::tibble(
      chr   = as.character(GenomicRanges::seqnames(gr)),
      start = min(GenomicRanges::start(gr)),
      end   = max(GenomicRanges::end(gr))
    ))
  }
  
  # If transcripts is already a tibble/data.frame, infer common column names
  tx_df <- as.data.frame(transcripts)
  
  possible_gene_cols <- intersect(gene_cols, colnames(tx_df))
  chr_col   <- intersect(c("seqnames", "seqname", "chr", "chrom", "chromosome"), colnames(tx_df))[1]
  start_col <- intersect(c("start", "tx_start", "transcript_start", "gene_start"), colnames(tx_df))[1]
  end_col   <- intersect(c("end", "tx_end", "transcript_end", "gene_end"), colnames(tx_df))[1]
  
  if (length(possible_gene_cols) == 0 || is.na(chr_col) || is.na(start_col) || is.na(end_col)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  hit <- rep(FALSE, nrow(tx_df))
  for (cc in possible_gene_cols) {
    hit <- hit | as.character(tx_df[[cc]]) == as.character(gene_id)
  }
  
  if (!any(hit)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  tx_hit <- tx_df[hit, , drop = FALSE]
  
  chr_vals <- as.character(tx_hit[[chr_col]])
  chr_vals <- ifelse(grepl("^chr", chr_vals), chr_vals, paste0("chr", chr_vals))
  
  tibble::tibble(
    chr   = chr_vals[1],
    start = min(as.integer(tx_hit[[start_col]]), na.rm = TRUE),
    end   = max(as.integer(tx_hit[[end_col]]), na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

parse_variant_point <- function(variant_id, default_chr = NULL) {
  # Handles common variant formats:
  #   chr4_185202643_C_G
  #   4:185202643[b38]C,G
  #   4:185202643:C:G
  #   chr4:185202643:C:G
  
  variant_id <- as.character(variant_id)
  
  if (is.na(variant_id) || !nzchar(variant_id)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  if (grepl("^chr[^_]+_[0-9]+_", variant_id)) {
    parts <- strsplit(variant_id, "_")[[1]]
    chr <- parts[1]
    pos <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(parts[2]))
    
  } else if (grepl("^[^:]+:[0-9]+\\[b[0-9]+\\]", variant_id)) {
    chr <- sub(":.*$", "", variant_id)
    pos <- suppressWarnings(
      as.integer(sub("^[^:]+:([0-9]+)\\[b[0-9]+\\].*$", "\\1", variant_id))
    )
    chr <- paste0("chr", sub("^chr", "", chr))
    
  } else if (grepl("^[^:]+:[0-9]+", variant_id)) {
    chr <- sub(":.*$", "", variant_id)
    pos <- suppressWarnings(
      as.integer(sub("^[^:]+:([0-9]+).*$", "\\1", variant_id))
    )
    chr <- paste0("chr", sub("^chr", "", chr))
    
  } else {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  if (is.na(pos)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  if (!is.null(default_chr)) {
    chr <- paste0("chr", sub("^chr", "", chr))
    default_chr <- paste0("chr", sub("^chr", "", default_chr))
    
    if (chr != default_chr) {
      return(NULL)
    }
  }
  
  tibble::tibble(chr = chr, start = pos, end = pos)
}

make_span_region <- function(chr, coord_bounds,
                             min_width,
                             buffer = 5000L,
                             center_pos = NULL) {
  # Defines the plotting region as min(anchor positions/features) to max(anchor positions/features),
  # plus a buffer. If the span is smaller than min_width, it expands around the span midpoint.
  chr <- paste0("chr", sub("^chr", "", chr))
  
  coord_bounds <- coord_bounds %>%
    dplyr::filter(chr == !!chr) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(start), !is.na(end))
  
  if (nrow(coord_bounds) == 0) {
    if (is.null(center_pos)) {
      stop("make_span_region needs either coord_bounds or center_pos")
    }
    
    start <- max(1L, as.integer(center_pos - min_width / 2))
    end   <- as.integer(center_pos + min_width / 2)
  } else {
    start <- max(1L, min(coord_bounds$start, na.rm = TRUE) - as.integer(buffer))
    end   <- max(coord_bounds$end, na.rm = TRUE) + as.integer(buffer)
    
    current_width <- end - start
    
    if (current_width < min_width) {
      mid <- floor((start + end) / 2)
      half_width <- ceiling(min_width / 2)
      start <- max(1L, mid - half_width)
      end   <- mid + half_width
    }
  }
  
  region <- paste0(chr, ":", start, "-", end)
  
  list(
    width    = as.integer(end - start),
    region   = region,
    gr       = str_to_gr(region),
    minStart = as.integer(start),
    maxEnd   = as.integer(end)
  )
}

zoom_gr <- function(gr, width = 40000L) {
  center <- round((GenomicRanges::start(gr) + GenomicRanges::end(gr)) / 2)
  
  GenomicRanges::GRanges(
    seqnames = GenomicRanges::seqnames(gr),
    ranges = IRanges::IRanges(
      start = pmax(1L, center - width / 2),
      end   = center + width / 2
    )
  )
}

qc_log <- vector("list", nrow(all_res_cbpnet_top))

all_res_cbpnet_top
# ============================================================
# Loop through all examples in all_res_cbpnet_top
# ============================================================
for (idx in seq_len(nrow(all_res_cbpnet_top))) {
  idx=3
  df <- all_res_cbpnet_top[idx, , drop = FALSE]
  
  gene          <- df$gene[[1]]
  variant       <- df$chrombpnet_var_id[[1]]
  caqtl_variant <- df$caQTL_variant[[1]]
  eqtl_variant  <- df$eQTL_variant[[1]]
  
  plot_id <- paste0(
    sprintf("%03d", idx), "_",
    gene, "_",
    gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9._-]", "_", variant)
  )
  
  message("Plotting ", idx, "/", nrow(all_res_cbpnet_top), ": ", gene, " | ", variant)
  
  stage <- "parse variant and define windows"
  
  qc_log[[idx]] <- tryCatch({
    
    vp <- parse_variant_id(variant)
    var_contig <- vp$chr
    var_pos    <- vp$pos
    
    chr_num <- sub("^chr", "", var_contig)
    
    region_ca <- gsub(
      paste0("^", chr_num, ":"),
      "",
      df$region.x[[1]]
    )
    
    region_eq <- gsub(
      paste0("^", chr_num, ":"),
      "",
      df$region.y[[1]]
    )
    
    peak_ca <- df$peak[[1]]
    gene_eq <- gene
    
    # ============================================================
    # Automatic coordinate-span windows
    # Uses the actual positions for this example:
    #   - ChromBPNet variant
    #   - caQTL lead/coloc variant
    #   - eQTL lead/coloc variant
    #   - caPeak interval
    #   - gene/transcript interval
    # Then defines each plotting window as min(anchor) to max(anchor) plus buffer.
    # ============================================================
    
    chrombpnet_point <- parse_variant_point(variant, default_chr = var_contig)
    caqtl_point      <- parse_variant_point(caqtl_variant, default_chr = var_contig)
    eqtl_point       <- parse_variant_point(eqtl_variant, default_chr = var_contig)
    
    peak_bounds <- get_peak_bounds(
      peak_id = peak_ca,
      bed_peaks_gr = bed_peaks_gr
    )
    
    gene_bounds <- get_gene_bounds(
      gene_id = gene_eq,
      transcripts = transcripts
    )
    
    anchor_bounds <- dplyr::bind_rows(
      chrombpnet_point,
      caqtl_point,
      eqtl_point,
      peak_bounds,
      gene_bounds
    )
    
    anchor_bounds3 <- dplyr::bind_rows(
      chrombpnet_point
    )
    
    
    # ============================================================
    # Plotting windows
    # ============================================================
    
    # Fixed broad/QTL plotting region around ChromBPNet variant
    # NOTE: 40000L means +/- 40 kb, so total width is ~80 kb.
    region_window_broad <- 180000L
    
    region_broad <- paste0(
      var_contig, ":",
      max(1L, var_pos - region_window_broad),
      "-",
      var_pos + region_window_broad
    )
    
    region_broad_gr <- str_to_gr(region_broad)
    
    # Use the same fixed region for the caQTL/eQTL scatter panels
    region_zoom2    <- region_broad
    region_zoom2_gr <- region_broad_gr
    
    minStart <- max(1L, var_pos - region_window_broad)
    maxEnd   <- var_pos + region_window_broad
    
    # Coverage zoom: still automatic span of ChromBPNet variant, caQTL/eQTL lead variants,
    # caPeak, and gene, with buffer.
    zoom2_5_auto <- make_span_region(
      chr = var_contig,
      coord_bounds = anchor_bounds,
      min_width = 2000L,
      buffer = 15000L,
      center_pos = var_pos
    )
    
    region_zoom2_5    <- zoom2_5_auto$region
    region_zoom2_5_gr <- zoom2_5_auto$gr
    
    zoom33_auto <- make_span_region(
      chr = var_contig,
      coord_bounds = anchor_bounds3,
      min_width = 15000L,
      buffer = 2000L,
      center_pos = var_pos
    )
    
    region_zoom33    <- zoom33_auto$region
    region_zoom33_gr <- zoom33_auto$gr
    
    # region_zoom33_gr <- zoom_gr(
    #   zoom33_auto$gr,
    #   width = 20000L
    # )
    # 
    # region_zoom33 <- paste0(
    #   as.character(GenomicRanges::seqnames(region_zoom33_gr)),
    #   ":",
    #   GenomicRanges::start(region_zoom33_gr),
    #   "-",
    #   GenomicRanges::end(region_zoom33_gr)
    # )

    # Local ChromBPNet prediction/contribution windows stay centered on ChromBPNet variant
    region_window_broad3 <- 200L
    region_window        <- 55L
    
    region_zoom3 <- paste0(
      var_contig, ":",
      max(1L, var_pos - region_window_broad3),
      "-",
      var_pos + region_window_broad3
    )
    
    region_zoom <- paste0(
      var_contig, ":",
      max(1L, var_pos - region_window),
      "-",
      var_pos + region_window
    )
    
    region_variant <- paste0(
      var_contig, ":",
      var_pos,
      "-",
      var_pos + 1
    )
    
    caqtl_pos_for_flank <- if (!is.null(caqtl_point) && nrow(caqtl_point) > 0) caqtl_point$start[[1]] else var_pos

    # Use the actual left/right span for grouped genotype coverage import.
    # prepareTrackData_grouped_genotype expects flanking around the caQTL variant,
    # so calculate the required distance from the caQTL position to region_zoom2_5.
    caqtl_pos_for_flank <- if (!is.null(caqtl_point) && nrow(caqtl_point) > 0) caqtl_point$start[[1]] else var_pos
    flank_left  <- max(5000L, as.integer(caqtl_pos_for_flank - zoom2_5_auto$minStart + 1000L))
    flank_right <- max(5000L, as.integer(zoom2_5_auto$maxEnd - caqtl_pos_for_flank + 1000L))
    
    # ============================================================
    # caQTL finemapping scatter
    # ============================================================
    stage <- "caQTL fine-mapping scatter"
    
    prep_ca   <- prepare_caqtl_data(var_contig, peak_ca, region_ca, caqtl_variant)
    markers_ca <- prep_ca$markers
    LD_ca      <- prep_ca$LD
    
    markers_ca <- markers_ca %>%
      mutate(
        pos_hg38 = as.integer(str_extract(marker, "(?<=:)\\d+")),
        z_pos0   =z_caqtl
      ) %>%
      add_ld_from_lead(LD_ca, lead_pos = var_pos)
    
    p.caqtl <- plot_qtl_scatter(
      markers_df = markers_ca,
      minStart   = minStart,
      maxEnd     = maxEnd,
      region     = region_zoom2_5,
      label_txt  = paste0("caQTL ", caqtl_variant, " ", peak_ca)
    ) +       geom_vline(
        xintercept = var_pos,
        color = "#0071ba",
        linewidth = 0.8
      ) +
      geom_vline(
        xintercept = caqtl_point$start,
        color = "#9ccb86",
        linewidth = 0.8
      ) 
    #=======================================================
    # eQTL finemapping scatter
    # ============================================================
    stage <- "eQTL fine-mapping scatter"
    
    eqtl_variant <- df$eQTL_variant[[1]]
    
    prep_eq   <- prepare_eqtl_data(var_contig, gene_eq, region_eq, variant)
    markers_eqtl <- prep_eq$markers
    LD_eqtl      <- prep_eq$LD
    
    markers_eqtl <- markers_eqtl %>%
      mutate(
        pos_hg38 = as.integer(str_extract(marker, "(?<=:)\\d+")),
        z_pos0   = z_eqtl
      ) %>%
      add_ld_from_lead(LD_eqtl, lead_pos = var_pos)
    
    p.eqtl <- plot_qtl_scatter(
      markers_df = markers_eqtl,
      minStart   = minStart,
      maxEnd     = maxEnd,
      region=region_zoom2_5,
      label_txt  = paste0("eQTL ", eqtl_variant, " ", gene_eq)
    ) +  
      geom_vline(
      xintercept = var_pos,
      color = "#0071ba",
      linewidth = 0.8
    ) +
      geom_vline(
        xintercept = eqtl_point$start,
        color = "#c7197c",
        linewidth = 0.8
      )
    
    # ============================================================
    # Observed ATAC coverage + peaks + genes
    # ============================================================
    stage <- "broad observed ATAC, peaks and genes"
    atac_sub <- import.bw(paths$bw_path, which = region_broad_gr)
    
    atac_cov <- trackplot_bw(
      bw          = atac_sub,
      region      = region_broad,
      facet_label = "ATAC",
      plot_as     = "area",
      tile_width  = 1,
      track_label = "ATAC",
      color       = "darkgreen"
    ) +
      highlight_region(region_zoom, color = "#0071ba", alpha = 0.2) +
      highlight_region(region_zoom2_5, color = "yellow", alpha = 0.2) +
      theme(legend.position = "none", plot.title = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0.5)) 
    
    
    p.peak_delim <- trackplot_peak_delim(bed_peaks_gr, region_broad, "darkgreen") +
      highlight_region(region_zoom, color = "#0071ba", alpha = 0.2) +
      highlight_region(region_zoom2_5, color = "yellow", alpha = 0.2) +
      theme(legend.position = "none", plot.title = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0.5))
    
    track_genes <- trackplot_gene_custom(transcripts, str_to_gr(region_broad)) +
      guides(color = "none") +
      highlight_region(region_zoom, color = "#0071ba", alpha = 0.2) +
      highlight_region(region_zoom2_5, color = "yellow", alpha = 0.2) +
      theme(legend.position = "none", plot.title = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0.5))
    
  
    # ============================================================
    # Observed ATAC coverage + peaks + genes (ZOOMED)
    # ============================================================
    stage <- "zoomed grouped genotype coverage"
    track_data <- prepareTrackData_grouped_genotype(
      variant_id = caqtl_variant,
      metadata   = metadata,
      base_dir   = paths$dir,
      bigwig_dir = paths$bigwig_dir,
      flanking = c(flank_left, flank_right)
    )
    
    if (df$beta.y[[1]] > 0) {
      # ALT allele increases accessibility, so Alt > Ref
      genotype_levels <- c("Homozygous Alt", "Heterozygous", "Homozygous Ref")
    } else {
      # REF allele increases accessibility, so Ref > Alt
      genotype_levels <- c("Homozygous Ref", "Heterozygous", "Homozygous Alt")
    }
    
    p.peaks <- plotGroupedCoverage_allelic_fill(
      track_data, region_zoom2_5_gr,
      genotype_levels = genotype_levels,
      rasterize = TRUE, raster_dpi = qc_dpi, alpha = 0.5) +  
      geom_vline(
        xintercept = var_pos,
        color = "#0071ba",
        linewidth = 0.8
      ) +
      geom_vline(
        xintercept = eqtl_point$start,
        color = "#c7197c",
        linewidth = 0.8
      ) +
      geom_vline(
        xintercept = caqtl_point$start,
        color = "#9ccb86",
        linewidth = 0.8
      ) 
    
    
    p.peak_delim2_5 <- trackplot_peak_delim(bed_peaks_gr, region_zoom2_5, "darkgreen") +  
      geom_vline(
        xintercept = var_pos,
        color = "#0071ba",
        linewidth = 0.8
      )+
      geom_vline(
        xintercept = eqtl_point$start,
        color = "#c7197c",
        linewidth = 0.8
      ) +
      geom_vline(
        xintercept = caqtl_point$start,
        color = "#9ccb86",
        linewidth = 0.8
      ) 
    
    track_genes2_5 <- trackplot_gene_custom(transcripts, str_to_gr(region_zoom2_5)) +
      guides(color = "none")
    
    
    ##zooom 3
    p.peaks3 <- plotGroupedCoverage_allelic_fill(
      track_data, region_zoom33_gr,
      genotype_levels = genotype_levels,
      rasterize = TRUE, raster_dpi = qc_dpi, alpha = 0.5) +  
      geom_vline(
        xintercept = var_pos,
        color = "#0071ba",
        linewidth = 0.8
      )
    
    
    p.peak_delim3 <- trackplot_peak_delim(bed_peaks_gr, region_zoom33, "darkgreen") +  
      geom_vline(
        xintercept = var_pos,
        color = "#0071ba",
        linewidth = 0.8
      )
    
    track_genes3 <- trackplot_gene_custom(transcripts, str_to_gr(region_zoom33)) +  
      geom_vline(
        xintercept = var_pos,
        color = "#0071ba",
        linewidth = 0.8
      )
    # ============================================================
    # Export / import ChromBPNet bigWigs for the variant
    # ============================================================
    stage <- "export/import ChromBPNet bigWigs"
    variant_bw_outdir <- file.path(qc_outdir, "bw_out", plot_id)
    dir.create(variant_bw_outdir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
    
    res <- export_variant_bigwigs_safe(
      pred_h5          = paths$data_h5,
      attr_h5          = paths$atrr,
      tsv_path         = paths$tsv,
      variant_id       = variant,
      chrom_sizes_path = paths$chrom_sizes,
      outdir           = variant_bw_outdir,
      write_channels   = FALSE
    )
    
    ref_bw      <- import.bw(res$pred_REF)
    alt_bw      <- import.bw(res$pred_ALT)
    atrr_ref_bw <- import.bw(res$contribSum_REF)
    atrr_alt_bw <- import.bw(res$contribSum_ALT)
    
    # ============================================================
    # Pred + contribution tracks
    # ============================================================
    stage <- "ChromBPNet prediction and contribution tracks"
    pred <- trackplot_bw_allelic(
      bw_ref      = ref_bw,
      bw_alt      = alt_bw,
      region      = region_zoom3,
      track_label = "ATAC signal",
      facet_label = "ATAC signal",
      score_cmap  = c(ref = "darkgreen", alt = "darkviolet"),
      ymin_zero   = TRUE,
      score_shift = 1
    ) +
      highlight_region(region_zoom, color = "skyblue", alpha = 0.2) +
      theme(legend.position = "none", plot.title = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0.5)) 
    
    all_scores <- c(as.numeric(mcols(atrr_ref_bw)$score), as.numeric(mcols(atrr_alt_bw)$score))
    all_scores <- all_scores[is.finite(all_scores)]
    
    ymax <- max(all_scores) * 1.05
    ymin <- min(all_scores) * 1.05
    ylim_shared <- c(ymin, ymax)
    
    ymax_accuracy <- 10^as.integer(log10(0.01 * abs(ymax)))
    ymin_accuracy <- 10^as.integer(log10(0.01 * abs(ymin)))
    
    range_label <- sprintf(
      "[%s-%s]",
      scales::label_comma(accuracy = ymin_accuracy, big.mark = " ")(ymin),
      scales::label_comma(accuracy = ymax_accuracy, big.mark = " ")(ymax)
    )
    
    Ref_contribs <- trackplot_contribs(
      bw          = atrr_ref_bw,
      region      = region_zoom,
      genome      = BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38,
      ylim        = ylim_shared,
      range_label = range_label,
      track_label = "REF"
    ) +
      highlight_relative_region(region_window + 0.5, region_window + 1.5, color = "#0071ba", alpha = 0.25)
    
    Alt_contribs <- trackplot_contribs(
      bw          = atrr_alt_bw,
      region      = region_zoom,
      genome      = BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38,
      ylim        = ylim_shared,
      range_label = range_label,
      track_label = "ALT"
    ) +
      highlight_relative_region(region_window + 0.5, region_window + 1.5, color = "#0071ba", alpha = 0.25)
    
    track_hits <- trackplot_genome_annotation(
      loci        = motifs,
      region      = region_zoom,
      color_by    = "motifs_disrupted",
      show_strand = TRUE,
      colors      = c("#0071ba", "gray"),
      label_size  = 3,
      label_by    = "TF_family",
      track_label = "TF Motifs"
    )
    
    
    # ============================================================
    # Combine trackplot
    # ============================================================
    stage <- "combine track plots"
    title_txt <- paste0(variant, ": ", str_to_pretty(region_zoom))
    
    track_plot <- trackplot_combine2(
      list(
        BPCells:::wrap_trackplot(p.caqtl,       unit(0.20, "null")) + indiv_theme,
        BPCells:::wrap_trackplot(p.eqtl,        unit(0.20, "null")) + indiv_theme
        # BPCells:::wrap_trackplot(atac_cov,      unit(0.18, "null")) + indiv_theme,
        # BPCells:::wrap_trackplot(p.peak_delim,  unit(0.10, "null")) + indiv_theme,
        # BPCells:::wrap_trackplot(track_genes,   unit(0.10, "null")) + indiv_theme
        
      ),
      title = title_txt
    )
    
    track_plot2 <- trackplot_combine2(
      list(
        BPCells:::wrap_trackplot(pred,          unit(0.22, "null")) + indiv_theme,
        BPCells:::wrap_trackplot(Ref_contribs,  unit(0.17, "null")) + indiv_theme,
        BPCells:::wrap_trackplot(Alt_contribs,  unit(0.17, "null")) + indiv_theme,
        BPCells:::wrap_trackplot(track_hits,    unit(0.10, "null")) + indiv_theme
        
      ),
      title = title_txt
    )
    
    track_plot3 <- trackplot_combine2(
      list(
        BPCells:::wrap_trackplot(p.peaks,      unit(0.22, "null")) + indiv_theme,
        BPCells:::wrap_trackplot(p.peak_delim2_5,  unit(0.10, "null")) + indiv_theme,
        BPCells:::wrap_trackplot(track_genes2_5,   unit(0.10, "null")) + indiv_theme
        
      ),
      title = title_txt
    )
    
    track_plot4 <- trackplot_combine2(
      list(
        BPCells:::wrap_trackplot(p.peaks3,      unit(0.22, "null")) + indiv_theme,
        BPCells:::wrap_trackplot(p.peak_delim3,  unit(0.10, "null")) + indiv_theme,
        BPCells:::wrap_trackplot(track_genes3,   unit(0.10, "null")) + indiv_theme
        
      ),
      title = title_txt
    )
    
    #pt1<-cowplot::plot_grid(track_plot2,track_plot3, align = "h")
    pt<-cowplot::plot_grid(track_plot,track_plot4, track_plot3, track_plot2, nrow = 2, align = "v", rel_widths = c(0.4, 0.6))
    
    print(pt)
    # ============================================================
    # Save low-resolution QC plot
    # ============================================================
    stage <- "save QC PNG"
    plot_file <- file.path(qc_outdir, paste0(plot_id, "_QC.pdf"))
    
    ggsave(
      filename  = plot_file,
      plot      = pt,
      width     = qc_width,
      height    = qc_height,
      units     = "in",
      dpi       = qc_dpi,
      limitsize = FALSE
    )
    
    tibble(
      index   = idx,
      gene    = gene,
      variant = variant,
      stage   = "completed",
      file    = plot_file,
      status  = "saved",
      error   = NA_character_
    )
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    
    message("Failed: ", gene, " | ", variant, " -- ", conditionMessage(e))
    
    tibble(
      index   = idx,
      gene    = gene,
      variant = variant,
      stage   = stage,
      file    = NA_character_,
      status  = "failed",
      error   = conditionMessage(e)
    )
  })
}

# ============================================================
# Export QC plotting log
# ============================================================
qc_log <- bind_rows(qc_log)

write_csv(
  qc_log,
  file.path(qc_outdir, "qc_plotting_log.csv")
)

print(qc_log %>% count(status))
print(qc_log %>% dplyr::filter(status == "failed"))
